Name: Hardcore Combat
Author: Vladislavjzk
Description:
[center][b][size=5]Compatible with Stardew Valley v1.6!
[/size][/b][b][size=5]Mod adds 8 combat difficulties:[/size][/b][/center][b][size=1]
[/size][/b][list]
[*][size=3]Very Easy — You are immune to any damage, debuffs and your damage is multiplied by 5.[/size]
[*][size=3]Easy — +5 defense and +20% damage.[/size]
[*][size=3]Normal — Vanilla (default).[/size]
[*][size=3]Hard — -8 defense.[/size]
[*][size=3]Advanced — -8 defense, -8 attack, and Monster Musk debuff.[/size]
[*][size=3]Expert — -8 defense, -8 attack, Darkness, and Monster Musk debuffs.[/size]
[*][size=3]Master — -8 defense, -20 attack, -1 speed, Darkness, and Monster Musk debuffs.[/size]
[*][size=3]Legendary — -11 defense, -23 attack, -2 speed, Darkness, Monster Musk, and Nauseated (can't restore HP) debuffs.[/size]
[/list]
[size=4]Effects only occur in [b]Mines[/b], [b]Skull Cavern[/b], and [b]Volcano dungeon[/b].

Also, if you want to experiment with optional debuffs, you have 9 options to choose.[/size]

[size=4][b]Installation & Usage:[/b][/size][size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿﻿[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3]Download the zipped file, and unzip its full contents into your Stardew Valley\Mods\folder.[/size]
[size=3]
[/size][/list][b][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Vladislavjzk/mods?_gl=1*139zlcy*_ga*MjEzODU5MTAyMy4xNzEwOTQ0MDMx*_ga_N0TELNQ37M*MTcxNDcxMzgzMi4xMzMuMS4xNzE0NzE2ODQyLjAuMC4w][size=5]Also, you can check my other mods[/size][/url]﻿[/b][size=3]
[size=5][b]If you have any suggestions or feedback about the mod, write in comments:)[/b][/size]
[/size]
